criteria.text: Manual smoke on v18.39: adding Visalia CRC as collaborator on a task persists the chip AND opens the agent chat bubble within ~10s.
isPendingAgent('__pending__') is true; isPendingAgent of other values is false. The sentinel constant is the exact string '__pending__'.

filterStalePendingErrors drops 'system' role messages starting with 'Error:' when isPending=true, keeps the task-context system message and other roles; passes everything through unchanged when isPending=false.
criteria.test_id: issue-651-c7: filterStalePendingErrors drops persisted server error frames when session is __pending__ but keeps task-context system msg

criteria.text: computeIsLocalSmokeRun honors RHYTHM_LOCAL_SMOKE=1 env var ONLY in debug builds (kDebugMode=true). In release builds the env var is ignored and an onIgnoredInRelease callback fires. --dart-define always wins regardless of build mode.
